notes: R8-LID-LEDGE-01 is the current working revision, explicitly selected after the user approved the connected front/back lid retaining ledges. Ongoing prototyping describes the whole 10BOX-v2 project.

Only the two central ledge gaps in each front/back lid panel change from R8. The two outer bracket windows, mounting holes, locating tongue, bounds and all other case parts are retained. The common front/back part is printed twice.

The complete print set contains 15 projects, 22 stored objects, 23 physical parts and 16 plate runs. Two lid projects receive the approved geometry; the other 13 are byte-identical to R8. Saved H2D settings and placements are preserved.

R5-R8 sources, archives and generation receipts remain immutable dependencies and historical evidence. manifest.json retains its original R5 input/hash contract; generation-time pending labels do not override the current selection.

Current selection is not physical validation or production approval. Native Studio load/slice and physical print/fit/load remain unperformed. Artifact hashes and verification are recorded in artifact_registry.
